newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer on higher dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer on higher dollar demand.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,506-1,510 per dollar, down from 1,501-1,504 at midday and 1,500-1,508 in the morning, due to a rise in dollar demand in late afternoon, dealers said.

"Banks and clients began bidding for relatively large dollar volumes for position squaring and pending payments and this pressured the lev by five to six (levs per dollar) from midday levels," a commercial bank dealer said.
The central bank was not seen countering the lev drop, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Dealers said trade was generally calm and in light volumes for most of the day and dollar demand was not expected to continue rising tomorrow. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
